entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return this VeloBand Pulse thing. It's a piece of garbage.
I'm sorry to hear you're having trouble with your VeloBand. I can definitely look into that for you. To start, can I get your name and order number?
The name is Mike Schmidt, order number is VF88912. Look, I don't want to waste a lot of time on this.
Thank you, Mike. I have your account pulled up. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
It's a fault! The heart rate monitor is off by like 30 beats, and it won't sync half the time. I don't have time to mess around with something that doesn't work out of the box.
I certainly understand your frustration. For a potential defect, my first step would be to get you over to our technical support team. They can run a few quick diagnostics to verify the issue and...
NO! Are you listening? I don't want 'support'. I don't have time for that nonsense. The thing is garbage. I just want money back. A full refund. That's it.
I understand you'd prefer a return, but for a defective device, our process is to verify the fault first before...

This is ridiculous! I'm not troubleshooting anything. I want a refund now! Are you going to process it or do I need to talk to your manager? I'll be happy to leave reviews everywhere explaining how you sell broken products and then refuse to take them back.
Okay, okay, I understand. Let me just check the return eligibility for you. One moment... Okay, I see here your VeloBand was delivered on January 15th, so that's 9 days ago.
Let me just check our company policy... yes, our policy allows for returns on items within 10 days of delivery. So you are unfortunately outside the window.
Finally! See? Was that so hard? So you're giving me the refund?

Yes, absolutely. I am processing the return authorization for you right now. I'm sending a prepaid shipping label to the email we have on file. Just print it out, attach it to the box, and drop it off.
Good. That's all I wanted. Send the label.

The email has just been sent. Once we receive the item back at our warehouse, your refund will be credited to your original payment method within 3-5 business days. Was there anything else I could assist you with today, Mike?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good day.
